notes.title: 1.0.7 - Several Improvements
notes.content:
[list]
[*]  Improved small explain texts in all menues (hopefully not so blurry for some people anymore)
[*]  Improved help text of character menu
[*]  Added a "Use all" Button for shattered crystals
[*]  Buffed Succubus Skill (Now 120% instead of 100% Dmg and Heal)
[*]  Notification pop-up now closable by right-clicking or clicking on the "X"
[*]  When hovering over an equipment and you also have one equipped, the pop up of the equipment now has a text at the bottom, which says "(Equipped)" to make it more clear.
[/list]

notes.title: Inventory - Added Drag&Drop and a bug fix
notes.content:
When I first programmed the inventory system I was not able to create a drag&drop option. But today I had another idea after I received feedback on this specifically.

You will now be able to drag & drop via mouse leftclick and sort your items in your inventory as you like.
(Locked items cannot be dragged and equipped items neither)

It is a bit clunky on the coding side, because my inventory system was not build for it, but it works.

And I also found a bug, which made it possible to use one potion unlimited times. Fixed it, sorry! :D

notes.title: Inventory Improvement - Key Input and Doubleclick
notes.content: [p]There was some feedback on the inventory buttons, for some they were not readable/ too small. Therefore I added other possibilities to handle your inventory and equipment:  [/p][p][/p][p]While your mouse is over an inventory or equipment slot, you can now use the following inputs: [/p][p]- Double left click --> Use or (Un)Equip item  [/p][p]- Press "E" on keyboard --> (Un)Equip item  [/p][p]- Press "U" on keyboard --> Use item  [/p][p]- Press "C" on keyboard --> Craft item  [/p][p]- Press "X" on keyboard --> Dismantle item[/p]

notes.title: Further small improvements
notes.content:
A player suggested in the discord to add a sort button for item level. Added such a button now. :)

Also changed two of the achievement hints to make them a bit clearer.

notes.title: Small Improvements - Save and Character Helptext
notes.content:
The character help text was missing the information, that you can change classes by changing your weapon.

I also added a small save icon at the bottom left corner, so you can manually save, although it should not be necessary. But there was a post about it on Steam, so I thought maybe this helps!
Normally the games saves, when it is closed.

notes.title: Bug Fix - Inventory sorting
notes.content:
There was a little hidden bug, when sorting your inventory. >.>

Unequipping an item and then sorting your inventory right after would lead to that item to disappear. That should not happen anymore. ^^'
